title.narrative: Providing sustainable water sources by drilling and repairing strategic, solar-powered artesian wells for drought-affected communities in the Federal Republic of Somalia.

description.narrative: Drilling, building and equipping 24 deep artesian wells (120-400 m) in the most needy areas in the Federal Republic of Somalia (according to the attached map), rehabilitating and repairing 20 broken artesian wells in the Federal Republic of Somalia benefiting 1,058,960 beneficiaries.
Improving and increasing the opportunities of the population, target communities and their livestock to clean drinking water by providing permanent and renewable sources of water.

Providing permanent and renewable sources of clean drinking water. This is done by drilling new strategic wells in the targeted areas where there are no other sources of water, and rehabilitating and repairing broken artesian wells in order to increase the opportunities for beneficiaries and their livestock to obtain clean water and thus contribute to reducing and mitigating the effects of drought. Of its aftershocks during dry seasons
